item.title: A bilingual Digest, restored movements and cron admin
item.description: The Digest is preparing an English version, accessible via a discreet FR/GB selector, whilst continuing to work on its translation in batches. The ‘About’ tooltip adapts to narrow windows and accessibility changes, and the tags resume their behaviour after the page is refreshed. The Node environment for the admin cron is documented and aligned with Node 22.

item.title: Curation is making its way into Firefox
item.description: The curation extension becomes a Chrome and Firefox extension based on the same code. The Firefox 1.5.0 version is validated, signed and then officially installed via AMO without extending the service’s trust to all the browser’s extensions. The feature on the ‘software factory’ becomes the first post published in the `FOCUS` format, alongside the two previous features on agent farms and ADEs, with a visual identity combining NASA technical archives, a grid layout and large typography.

item.title: The draft becomes an editorial version
item.description: Existing editions can now be corrected, published or returned to draft status via the admin panel. The catalogue distinguishes between links prepared for an edition and editorial withdrawals, which must remain offline.

item.title: Forty-five boxes and a few nets
item.description: A raw list of fifty GitHub references is transformed into a digest of forty-five resources that have been verified, deduplicated and grouped by use case. The archives are given a visual identity, with titles centred on the date and a grid without white gaps. The homepage and admin panel finally refine their margins and borders.

item.title: Repeat without deleting on LinkedIn
item.description: A LinkedIn resource can be republished without deleting its previous posts. The author field remains editable and SQLite retains every instance. The technical log becomes a standalone public mini-blog, without being incorporated into the OOBLIK Blog archives.

item.title: From the Swiss cartridge to the OOBLIK blog archive
item.description: The configurable categories provide the Digest with its system of headings and shared subheadings. This framework then organises the archive of 831 WordPress posts without confusing archived text, source and current destination. Any cases of uncertainty remain subject to human judgement.

item.title: The LinkedIn feed: from false success to a visible post
item.description: LinkedIn visuals use a 1200 × 1200-pixel square. Real-world testing reveals the API’s false successes and leads to synchronising uploads, enabling reposting and simplifying retrieval. Seventeen commits bring both the site and the administration to `v1.8.6`.

item.title: Stricter editorial measures and LinkedIn screenshots
item.description: Common editorial actions are now accessible via each link to the owner. LinkedIn screenshots now feature a graphical collapse option and Chromium-based navigation protected against private networks. Eleven commits consolidate the whole system and restore the Windows environment to working order.

item.title: Publication, visual identity and sharing on LinkedIn
item.description: The administration gains a post in a single action, with trackable progress. The site is given its full identity and a native LinkedIn share feature reserved for the owner. Thirty-three commits bring the catalogue to 3,992 links and 836 edits.

item.title: Éclipse du soleil sur une grille suisse
item.description: Translation pending · Une éclipse devient le point de départ d’une identité faite de Bricolage Grotesque, de JetBrains Mono, de noir, de papier et de corail. Le Journal du Digest prend forme avec Codex par une suite de prompts, d’essais et de contrôles dans le navigateur. Cette construction ouvre une seconde histoire : conserver et partager les URL, y compris lorsque le Web répond 404.

item.title: Administration et curation depuis Chrome
item.description: Translation pending · Le Digest passe d’une archive statique à un système de curation propriétaire avec administration, extension Chrome et publication atomique. Quinze commits et trente exécutions GitHub Actions réussies installent ce nouveau parcours.

item.title: Favoris locaux et nouvelles éditions
item.description: Translation pending · Trois anciens Digests composés à la main — les semaines 11, 12 et 14 de 2017 — rejoignent l’archive. Le site gagne aussi des favoris conservés uniquement dans le navigateur.

item.title: Exploration des tags et reprise de 2017
item.description: Translation pending · Deux anciens Digests composés à la main, les semaines 8 et 9 de 2017, rejoignent l’archive. L’explorateur de tags gagne un index alphabétique et les liens leurs favicons, tandis que les problèmes de cache sont résolus.

item.title: Naissance du Digest et restauration des liens perdus
item.description: Translation pending · Le Digest donne une nouvelle forme à une pratique plus ancienne : des sélections de liens composées à la main en HTML. Il prépare un même lieu pour les blogs WordPress, Tumblr, Instagram et les autres traces dispersées, sans effacer les adresses devenues fragiles ou mortes.
